Alpha Finance reports $15.7M long liquidations versus $528K short liquidations
Reuters reports dollar strength, higher US yields, yen intervention stress and geopolitical oil disruption
disconfirming_or_missing: No synchronized BTC/ETH/broad-risk comparison was admitted
No raw venue liquidation feed was captured
Alpha liquidation clusters are modelled and second-hand
Asynchronous spot snapshots do not establish event causality
